title: Out-of-bounds read through Swift unsafe buffer or imported C pointer
preconditions: untrusted count/index reaches UnsafeBufferPointer or raw pointer access
a Swift buffer and count are passed to a C reader
dangerous_transitions: pointer/count contract is widened or narrowed inconsistently across FFI
sink_semantics: unsafe buffer subscript and pointer advanced(by:)
C functions reading beyond the supplied pointer/count contract
counterevidence: Safe high-level Swift collection access retains runtime bounds checks.
The foreign pointer contract and owner lifetime are validated at the boundary.
verification_recipe: Trace length units, integer casts, and pointer offsets to the read.
Check initialized count and foreign function contract; use sanitizers where available.
